uniform_allocation: Existing Matrix4f reused; m10/m11 span and m20/m21 origin; m00 remains elapsed clock
admitted_height: CPU side UV uses shared target after stale revision guard, not stale mesh target
shader: Side V follows exact geometry displacement, clamps to corresponding still/full or flowing/half sprite range
lighting: Native block light low byte preserved; reserved UV2.x bits8/9 masked before light lookup; skylight unchanged
clock_and_opacity: Original 100ms height and opacity clocks/packed offsets unchanged
scope_limits: No whole-stream, ocean-wave, diagonal seam, per-primitive transparency or owner GPU/FPS acceptance
Double precision randomized algebra is not GPU float/performance evidence
No volume, simulation frequency, solver, LOD or terrain changes
fixture_isolation: Controlled buffers/atlas/targets released; isolated renderer worker shut down; no authoritative world edits from new side fixtures
